what: hàng rào cây cắt xén: a piece of 2 m of the clipped hedge along the paths of the park of Bãi Trước
uses: Plan 0026: the hedges along the paths of the park, in pieces of 2 m in a row along a line (ports start and end), as the pieces of the sidewalk of World.

drawing.name: hang_rao_cong_vien
sources: A piece of 2 m of the clipped hedge along the paths of the park of Bãi Trước: photos of 2014-04-06 (Commons, trungydang, CC BY 3.0) and 2018-03-08 (Flickr, Ricoucou); the sizes at the scale of the low lamp of the park (0.70 m) and of a stone bench (Vũng Tàu, data/world/drawings/hang_rao_cong_vien.json).

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: The park in the morning: a path of tiles with a granite curb, a low square white lamp at its side, clipped hedges along the paths with round top edges, round clipped bushes, two women on the path, a granite bench.

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: The park in the morning: a round flower bed, a low square white lamp, clipped hedges and round clipped bushes, painted cat sculptures, frangipani trees.

sources.author: Ricoucou (Flickr user 10598985@N07)
sources.shows: The park under frangipani trees: clipped hedges of small bright green leaves along the paths of red tiles, a rough stone bench beside a hedge, low square lamps, benches of granite.

sources.author: Ricoucou (Flickr user 10598985@N07)
sources.shows: The garden of sculptures of the park: rows of low clipped hedges with round top edges between lawns, benches of rough stone, stone sculptures, a low square lamp.

length.source: Not a size of the hedge: a piece of 2 m, the length of the pieces of World (the spec, Confirmed). The ends are flat, so pieces in a row make one hedge.

height.source: Photo 0 (2014): at the low lamp (0.70 m, 57 px from its foot to its cap), the top of the hedge behind it is 34 px over the lawn: 0.42 m. Photo 2 (2018): the top of the hedge beside the rough stone bench is a little under the top of its seat (about 0.9 of the height of the bench, and a seat is about 0.45 m high, as the dark bench of the park): 0.40 m.

width.source: Photo 0 (2014): the hedge by the near path is about 0.7 times the height of the low lamp beside it (0.70 m) wide: 0.49 m (the spec). Photo 2 (2018): the hedge beside the rough stone bench looks about as wide as it is high (0.4 m to 0.5 m).

round.source: Photos 0 (2014), 2 and 3 (2018): the top edges of the hedges are round, about a fifth of the height.

colors.value: leaves #3a541b, the clipped top #58772b, the foot #28390f
colors.source: Photo 0 (2014): the median of the hedge in the light of the morning is #27340c in the shade and #4c6a22 in the light; #3f5a1e between them (the spec); a little darker (#3a541b), because the top is painted lighter. Photos 2 and 3 (2018): the top of a hedge is lighter than its sides, and its foot is dark.

looks.seen: Next to photos 0 to 3: a long block of clipped leaves with round top edges and flat ends, 0.42 m high and 0.5 m wide, a lighter top and a dark foot, as the hedges along the paths. The clumps of the leaves are larger than the small leaves of the hedges in photos 2 and 3, and the green is a little light next to photo 0.
looks.changed: Smaller clumps of leaves (0.025 m), and a little darker green for the mass.

looks.seen: Smaller clumps of leaves, a little darker green, the light top and the dark foot: the hedge agrees with the clipped hedges of photos 0 to 3 in shape, size and color.
looks.changed: Nothing at the mid level. The near level with a bake of 1024 stopped the builder of the factory three times (HTTP 503: more memory than the edge has), so the near bake is now 512.

looks.seen: The same mid level as before (only the near bake changed).

A block of small clipped leaves with round top edges, flat ends for the next piece, a lighter top and a dark foot, as photos 0 and 2. The leaves are a pattern of the maps; the outline is smooth, as a hedge that was clipped.
